messages:
Olivia Chen: Hi everyone 👋 Olivia here, joining Product Infra today from MST. First day! Quick asks: where do I start for MDM & VPN? Who handles access to the 'realtime-models' GCP project? Also, fun fact: I kayak on weekends. Two truths & a lie: built a treehouse, can speak Portuguese, once ate a tarantula. :boat:
Sam (Onboarding): Welcome Olivia! Checklist sent to your email. Steps: accept Okta invite, follow the MDM link in the welcome email, then WireGuard profile should auto-provision. If not, reply here with the error message. I'll add you to #product-infra and the onboarding doc.
IT Desk: Olivia — laptop assigned (asset R-8088) and will ship today. MDM note: on macOS, if you hit "Installation failed", run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` then reboot. VPN: `brew install wireguard-tools` then import the .conf we emailed and run `wg-quick up redwood`. If you get "permission denied" when importing, try `sudo chown $USER ~/.config/wireguard` then re-import.
DevX Bot: account-created: GitHub invite sent; Slack: added to #new-hires and #product-infra; Calendar: 1:1 with Rhea scheduled.
Rhea: welcome! For GCP, open an infra request at https://intranet.redwood/infra-request and request project `realtime-models` with `roles/viewer` to start. Tag me and Marcus and I can expedite. Also FYI we have a standing "office hours" slot Thurs 2pm MST for platform Qs.
Olivia Chen: Thanks! A couple follow-ups: how do I request a second monitor and a standing desk? And where are the tiny-models to try locally?
Marcus Li: For equipment, use https://intranet.redwood/equipment-request -> select "peripherals" and set priority to "new hire". For tiny models/starter code: clone `git@github.com:redwood/dev-starters.git` then `cd dev-starters && ./scripts/run_local.sh --model redwood-tiny`. If you hit CUDA OOM, try `--device cpu` or set `export TORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:128`.
IT Desk: If MDM enrollment still fails after the profile renew, please paste the Console.app log snippet here and we'll take a look. For WireGuard, `wg show` output helps us debug (redact IPs).
Olivia Chen: Will post a short intro in #general later. Fun fact reveal incoming: I did build a tiny treehouse (true), I can muddle through Portuguese (true), the tarantula was a dare in college (lie). Also — oat milk latte for anyone local who wants to trade coffee tips! :coffee: :seedling:
